aboutHtml:
Alastair and Louise Thomson run STIHL SHOP Petone. We sell STIHL tools and outdoor power equipment through our shop and online, and our full service workshop keeps your gear running well for years. We stock STIHL, Hansa, Masport, Rover, Cub Cadet, Honda Power Equipment, Walker and Hustler.

We're part of the Hutt Valley community and proud to support local schools and sports clubs including Hutt High School Water Polo, HOBM Rugby, St Patrick's Silverstream, Hutt International Boys School and the Upper Hutt Axemens Club.

Come in and see us. Whether you need new equipment, repairs, spare parts or advice, we're here to help.
